In this list, the word law has been used only for such texts as have been passed by the Chinese Parliament. All the others are called Regulations or Rules, these denominations covering a number of distinctions in the Chinese terminology. The documents which have been translated in English or French by the Commission of Extraterritoriality are marked Tr. En. Ext. Com. or Tr. Fr. Ext. Com. Those which have appeared in the China Year Book are marked C.Y.B.
